sources.name: Atlas_LenderConditions_FICTIONAL.txt
sources.text:
Direct manipulation of the historical atlas must not begin until written lender consent has been presented; during that handling, a supporting book cradle and a padded transfer tray are mandatory, and a collections conservator must remain beside the reading table throughout the take; these conditions concern opening and unfolding the loaned volume, not an interview beside its closed case.

The lender letter describes Variation VA-17 as issued for the close-up in which the performer opens and unfolds the atlas only; it does not extend that variation to the case-only interview; the letter cites Consent Schedule CS-9 as its supporting instrument, but no copy accompanies this letter.
